fusions.name: Double Bit
fusions.desc: A two-edged chop that deals 7 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Felling Arc
fusions.desc: A full-weight cleave across the front, dealing 32 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Throwing Rack
fusions.desc: Drives a rack of hatchets into the ground for 10 seconds. It throws a hatchet at an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.2 seconds for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Edge on Edge
fusions.desc: Every critical hit you land builds a stack, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
